criteria.criterion:
`vloop fence hook --phase verify --root ` answers each Copilot payload with T1's verify decision, the reason being `vloop fence: ` and T1's message, exit 0; an unknown phase is the deny line with `unknown phase "

": want review, second-review, work or verify` and exit 2; the review, second-review and work phases answer exactly as before.
criteria.evidence: Hook phase came with T1 (internal/fence/judge.go:54, judge_test.go:257); T2 leaves it unchanged; fence_hook_test.go still pins the review/second-review answers and the unknown-phase exit 2.

criteria.criterion: `agent.verify` accepts `claude` (default) and `copilot`, from the file and from `VLOOP_AGENT_VERIFY`; `agent.plan` and `agent.gate-review` still refuse `copilot` (config set exits 2 with `want one of claude`; a run with their variable set to copilot starts no session).
criteria.evidence: config.go agent.verify Valid: reviewAgents; plan and gate-review still use agents; config_test.go:706 now accepts copilot for verify and checks refusal for the others.

criteria.criterion: With `agent.verify = copilot`, the verify session runs `copilot -p "/vloop:verify"` with the model and effort P-6 resolves, the plugin by `--plugin-dir`, a fresh home under `.vloop/tmp/` holding a hooks file that runs `fence hook --phase verify` in both command forms, the guidelines as custom instructions, and the same `--deny-tool` list as a Copilot review session — `--deny-tool=shell(rm:*)` and `--deny-tool=shell(git push:*)` included.
criteria.evidence: agent_copilot.go Supports(verify) true; Command skips shell(rm:*) only for work; Prepare/writeCopilotHooks take the phase; ResolveRun already resolves verify; TestCopilotVerifyArgvAndHooks asserts the prompt, whole deny list and --phase verify.

criteria.criterion: A Copilot verify session's JSON Lines become a `session/v4` record (schema `session/v4`, as a Copilot work record is — at the base a Copilot review record is `session/v3`, and that stays) with phase `verify`, agent `copilot`, the model, credits, estimated cost, `cost_source` and `permission_denials`; it validates as session/v4.
criteria.evidence: session.go:464 selects session/v4 for verify+copilot; TestCopilotVerifyRecordIsSessionV4 checks verify/copilot v4, verify/claude v3, review/copilot v3. The record fields are the existing Copilot path's; the checks log passes.

criteria.criterion: Everything around the verify session is unchanged whatever the agent: it runs only when `run.verify` is not `false`; `verify: no findings` or `verify: <n> finding(s) — see …reports/verify.json`; a valid `.vloop/tmp/verify.json` is kept as the run folder's `reports/verify.json`; a changed file is reverted with `vloop: the verify session changed <path> — reverted` and the report still kept; a moved ref halts with exit 9 and `REFS MOVED verify — a verify session changed git refs; nothing was committed`; a finding, a failed session or a missing report is a warning and the run exits 0. A Copilot verify session that changes the run's ending is a violation.
criteria.evidence: iterate.go is untouched in the diff; verifySession already takes the agent from it.resolved.Agent(PhaseVerify).

criteria.criterion: A Copilot work, review or second-review session's argv and hooks file are unchanged (work without `shell(rm:*)` and `--phase work`; review with it and `--phase review`); a Claude session's argv, fence and settings are unchanged — a Claude verify session still runs under the verify fence.
criteria.evidence: Command/hooks code is unchanged for the other phases; the only code changes are Supports and the record schema condition. The existing TestCopilotWorkArgvAndHooks remains.

criteria.criterion: Committed Go tests cover the adapter's verify-phase argv (the whole deny list, `shell(rm:*)` included), its hooks file's `--phase verify`, `Supports(verify)`, the verify record's schema, the hook's verify phase and `agent.verify` accepting copilot while `agent.plan` and `agent.gate-review` do not; tests that pinned verify as unsupported or `agent.verify` as claude-only change only to the new behaviour, and the work notes name the contract item (V1, V2).
criteria.evidence: agent_copilot_test.go adds TestCopilotVerifyArgvAndHooks and TestCopilotVerifyRecordIsSessionV4 and flips the Supports test; config_test.go:706 flips verify. The hook's verify phase is covered by T1's judge_test.go. The two flipped tests change only to the new behaviour (V2).
